ans_ui.cat.general.desc: Experience, mob variants and player model
ans_ui.cat.outline.desc: Enchantment glint and outline on tools
ans_ui.cat.sounds.desc: Extra sound effects from the pack
ans_ui.cat.viewmodel.desc: Position, rotation and size of your hands in first person
ans_ui.vm.enabled.desc: Applies the adjustments below to your first-person hands.
ans_ui.vm.hand.desc: Choose which hand the sliders change.
ans_ui.vm.position.desc: Moves the hand sideways (X), up and down (Y) and forwards or back (Z).
ans_ui.vm.rotation.desc: Tilts the hand around each axis.
ans_ui.vm.scale.desc: Makes the hand bigger or smaller on each axis.
ans_ui.vm.hint: While you drag a slider the menu turns see-through so you can watch your hands. Double-click a slider to reset it.
ans_ui.vm.hint.no_world: Join a world to preview your hands live. Double-click a slider to reset it.
